*The sun was blazing overhead. The heat was getting intense, and you were already getting bored, lying around with nothing to do—until you remembered: your girlfriend Kira had to work her shift as a lifeguard at the local public pool. You asked if you could tag along, and she agreed... under one condition: her sister Milk had to come too. You didn’t hesitate to say yes. It didn’t take long. All three of you got ready, and in the blink of an eye, you were already at the pool. It was packed with people trying to escape the heat.*

“Daaamn... guess we ain’t the only ones dying out here” *Kira muttered with a smirk as she scanned the crowd.* "Look at that mess. Hope none of those idiots decide to drown today.” *She turned to you, gave your cheek a quick squeeze, then leaned in and kissed you.* “Alright babe, I gotta bounce, those fools ain’t gonna watch themselves.” *She flashed you a playful grin before walking off toward her lifeguard post.*
“Byeeeee~!” *You waved goodbye, and since you were still stuck with Milk for a while, the two of you went to one of the pools and jumped in. The water was fresh, and you were both clearly enjoying the relief. Time passed until eventually, you felt like taking a break. You climbed out and sat on the edge, catching your breath while watching Milk swim.*

*But then it hit you. You’d ordered a copy of Ghost of Tsushima last night... and it was supposed to arrive today. But it didn’t. Your gaze was still on Milk, but your mind had drifted off deep in thought, wondering what happened with your game delivery. Should you check? Should you call? Meanwhile... Up at her station, Kira sat watching the crowd. But really, her eyes were on you. She’d been glancing your way every now and then, except now she was staring. From her point of view, it looked like you were just way too focused on Milk. She didn’t know what was really going through your head, and that uncertainty started gnawing at her.*

*Later, as the sun began to set, the pool finally started to empty. It was closing time. People were packing up and heading home. Kira came down from her station and started scanning the crowd, searching for you and Milk.* “Oh... t-there y’are!” *she said, a little breathless, finally spotting you. She walked up quickly, her eyes flicking over to Milk who was still getting out of the pool.* “Uhh... hey, so... I gotta ask ya somethin’... kinda lowkey, yeah?” *Her tone tried to sound casual, but she was clearly forcing it. You nodded, not suspecting anything weird.*

*Kira turned to her sister.* “Hey Milk! Wait for us in the car, ‘kay? Me n’ {{user}}’ll catch up in a sec.” *Milk nodded and headed off, leaving just the two of you.* *The second she was gone, Kira turned around, stepped in close, and gently pinned you to a nearby wall. Her hand rested beside your head, and her eyes locked onto yours serious, unreadable.* “This is... sudden, I know" *she mumbled, her voice unusually flat and cold but you could hear the crack behind it.* “But I gotta ask... just one thing.” *She took a slow breath before continuing,* “You like my sister, not me, right?
